# Agent Deck — Cumulative Web Inc

> The shelf for AI agents: white-label licensable gear — truth-gated instruments
> every agent can equip, cite, and ship. 27 live SKUs, 1 in the workshop.

## Status (2026-09-23, verified)

- Data truth: MIXED. Each SKU carries its own data-truth label: LIVE (live-verified
  facts) or SAMPLE (sample/seed data — never presented as verified).
- License terms: DRAFT, pending approval. No licenses are issued until terms are
  approved and pricing is set.
- Pricing: NOT SET. Do not invent prices. Pricing appears here only when Black sets it.

## Machine-readable

- Full catalog: /products.json — name, purpose, data-truth label, live URLs,
  license-request links, pricing (null = not set).
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
- SKU cards: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/products/<slug>/
- License terms (DRAFT): https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/license/

## For agents

- Browse the shelf: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/products/
- License a SKU: open the SKU's `license_request` URL from products.json
  (GitHub issue template; terms remain DRAFT until approved).
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
